name: Lucia
description: A fellow League contestant with brown hair, an orange jacket, and a silver Lapras necklace.

facts.text: She was overwhelmed by a journalist's rapid-fire questions and worries about how he might portray her.
You exchanged phone numbers aboard the ferry.
Her family has a Floatzel that follows her around, even when she goes shopping.
She has helped care for her family's Floatzel, but has never raised a Pokémon of her own.
She hopes her first Pokémon partner will like her.
She entered the League to explore wild Pokémon habitats, including Aurelia's wetlands, forests, and islands.
Her little brother gave her the Lapras necklace and wants photographs of Water-type Pokémon.
Lucia showed you the League's rule that Pokémon must willingly choose their trainers and may leave if mistreated.
She invited you to walk to the Civic Forum together before orientation.

name: Cassius
description: An ambitious contestant who studies the League's rankings and wants to earn his place in the final.

name: Octavia
description: A thoughtful contestant who questions how the League measures qualities such as judgment and compassion.

name: Victra
description: A League contestant at the Portico Hotel, trying to recover a misplaced suitcase containing her mother's travel journal.

facts.text: You found a lead on her missing suitcase and accompanied her to the annex to retrieve it.
You found a lead on her suitcase but left her to collect it from the hotel annex.

name: Livia
description: A League contestant who helped rescue a Wattrel tangled in the Salt and Thyme café awning.

facts.text: She appreciated your quick response to the struggling Wattrel.
She was disappointed that you checked your Pokédex before helping with the emergency.
You helped free the Wattrel from the awning.
